full_judgment: 12. But the High Courts of Bombay and Madras have, however, interpreted the expression "such transferee sues for partition" strictly. The views of the above two High Courts are that a shareholder shall have the right to apply under section 4 of the Partition Act, only when the transferee sues for partition after acquiring a share in the undivided family dwelling house (Ref Kunde Rao vs Bal Krishan, AIR 1922 Born 121 and Ramaiah vs Subba Rao, AIR 1950 Mad 214).
